errors.error: Hardware restart or invalid segment during benchmark

grafana_snapshot.method: Instant 24-hour avg_over_time of chia_timelord_estimated_ips gauge; not directly comparable with completion-event means

local_baseline_completions.methodology: Completion-log Estimated IPS observations, not time-sampled Grafana gauge averages; host log timezone America/Chicago

limitations: Short clock/status trials cannot establish long-term stability or causality.
Live windows have different proof-length distributions and different profiling overhead; completion means are not a precise performance comparison or Grafana gauge averages.
Unfinished construction-worker CPU is a lower bound: tail squaring and completed but unused checkpoints are excluded.
Mainnet long-term stability remains unproven; no 1M delivered IPS claim.
status_path_decision: Leave default combined-burst path unchanged; both paths had zero recoveries in the four short trials. Direct register path remains an opt-in diagnostic.
clock_decision: Hold 1500 MHz temporarily for live comparison and further stability observation; no sustained-stability claim.

live_comparison.methodology: Two alternating pairs at 1500 MHz / 1.0 V; each 180-second measurement window excludes 30-second warmup. Completion-event distributions are not Grafana gauge averages; differing proof lengths and profiling overhead limit performance inference.

reset_profile.core_sample_note: Samples are taken at form-access boundaries; these are not time-weighted CPU residency percentages.

reset_construction.note: Only jobs with a recorded natural reset request are included. Workers without a completed segment measure unfinished construction; completed but unused checkpoints and tail squaring are not counted. This is a lower bound on discarded CPU work.

reset_profile.legacy_coverage_note: The matched-window binary logged only finished worker CPU totals. Its zero unfinished counts are unobservable, not measurements of zero discarded CPU. The new separate capture logs completed=0 and completed=1 explicitly.

long_soak_status: Running: baseline 500K for six hours, then optimized candidate 250K for six hours; both 1500 MHz / 1.0 V. Long-term results pending.
checkpoint_decision: Test 250K in the long candidate soak. The screen improved matched receipts; the holdout improved deadline coverage intermittently, with one extra late receipt. Default 1M and original live 500K remain unchanged.
